Package com.aspose.cells_foss

Class WorksheetProtection

java.lang.Object
com.aspose.cells_foss.WorksheetProtection
public final class WorksheetProtection extends Object
Represents protection settings for a worksheet. Boolean allow-properties follow the Aspose.Cells convention: true means the operation IS allowed (i.e. NOT restricted), false means it is restricted. This is the inverse of the raw OOXML sheetProtection attribute values.
